items.summary: "You can't outsource accountability". items.summary: OpenRouter has removed three AI hosting providers and revoked Zero Data Retention eligibility for 125 endpoints after researchers found evidence that some providers had been compromised or had failed to follow their data policies. The findings did not show a breach of OpenRouter itself, and the company did not say how many users or conversations may have been exposed. items.title: Hackers Could Execute Commands on WordPress, Email and Print Servers Through Upload2Shell Flaw
items.summary: A flaw in Ghostscript let researchers run commands on WordPress, Roundcube webmail, and Linux print servers through routine file processing. The vulnerability, dubbed Upload2Shell and tracked as CVE-2026-125396, affects upstream Ghostscript releases before 10.08.0. It sits in the software’s Type 1 font loader, but the affected servers did not need to expose Ghostscript directly. Their own preview, thumbnail, and print features delivered files to it. items.summary: Attackers exploited a flaw in Microsoft Entra Connect Health to read administrator and technical contact email addresses, along with configuration data from affected organizations. A Microsoft customer notice shared on Reddit describes read-only access to those records, not access to inboxes or email messages. Microsoft fixed the flaw in its cloud service on November 19, 2026, and said customers do not need to install a patch.
